svg.title: 808 Pocket - Component breakdown
svg.desc: Figma-ready component board showing the visual system, transport controls, sequencer states, and pitched and noise-based mixer channels.

g.text: Reusable pieces from the desktop and mobile drum-machine screens.
Tap a step to switch it
Every voice has level; tonal voices also expose pitch from -12 to +12 semitones.
Pitch value readout uses semitones (st); zero is the synthesis default.
System sans for interface; monospace for labels, status and values.
Each top-level g element is named with an id to keep imported SVG artwork easier to inspect in Figma.
Families follow the web stack: system UI sans for interface copy, UI monospace for compact labels and numeric readouts.
DESKTOP SCALE AS SHOWN; MOBILE OVERRIDES APPLY AT ≤440 PX. CSS SOURCE: styles.css.
